expressjs||ai based automation (n8n), re:
Complete a beginner-friendly Express.js tutorial to understand routing, middleware, and request/response handling.
Resource: freeCodeCamp's "Backend Development and APIs" certification, focusing on the Node.js and Express.js sections. (Link: `https://www.freecodecamp.org/learn/back-end-development-and-apis/`)
Build a simple RESTful API (e.g., for managing a list of tasks or users) using Express.js and integrate it with a NoSQL database like MongoDB (using Mongoose).
Resource: The Net Ninja's "Node.js & Express Tutorial" playlist on YouTube. Specifically look for videos on connecting to MongoDB. (Link: `https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL4cUxeGkcC9jpz5gJccOxVQAMRObA62w`)
n8n||ai based automation (n8n), react, e:
Get started by setting up n8n locally or on a free cloud instance, then run through the official "Getting Started" guide to understand nodes, workflows, and triggers.
Resource: n8n Official Documentation - "Getting Started" section. (Link: `https://docs.n8n.io/getting-started/`)
Build a basic automation workflow that uses an HTTP Request node to call an external API (e.g., a public weather API) and then process/transform the data using a Function node.
Resource: n8n Learn tutorials on their website. Look for examples involving HTTP requests and data manipulation. (Link: `https://n8n.io/learn/`)
Experiment with integrating n8n with one of your existing skills, such as using a Python script or calling an LLM API through an HTTP Request node to automate a specific AI-related task.
Resource: Search the n8n community forum or YouTube for "n8n LLM integration" or "n8n Python script" for community examples and tutorials. (Link: `https://community.n8n.io/`)
professional full stack development expe:
Develop a complete full-stack application (e.g., an e-commerce platform, a social media clone, or a task management system) from scratch, integrating React for the frontend, Express.js for the backend API, and a database. Focus on features like user authentication, proper routing, and error handling.
Resource: freeCodeCamp's "Build a MERN Stack eCommerce App" or similar project-based tutorials on YouTube by channels like Academind or Traversy Media. (Example search: `https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=mern+stack+project`)
Learn to deploy your full-stack application to a cloud platform. Deploy the React frontend separately (e.g., Vercel, Netlify) and the Express.js backend (e.g., Render, Heroku free tier, or a basic AWS EC2 instance).
Resource: Official documentation and free tier guides for Vercel (frontend) and Render (backend). Many YouTube tutorials also cover MERN stack deployment. (Links: `https://vercel.com/docs`, `https://render.com/docs`)
Understand and implement basic development best practices such as version control branching strategies (Gitflow), writing clean code, and performing basic unit/integration testing for your backend API.
Resource: Learn Git Branching (interactive tutorial for Gitflow) at `https://learngitbranching.js.org/`. For testing, search YouTube/Google for "Express.js testing with Jest/Mocha tutorial".
